## 01. Characteristics of Study Population

```{r}
# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(survey)
library(srvyr)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
# Load analysis dataset
nhanes_analysis <- readRDS("data/nhanes_analysis.rds")
```

```{r}
# Define functions for geometric mean/sd reporting 
geo_mean <- function(x) exp(mean(log(x), na.rm = TRUE))
geo_sd   <- function(x) exp(sd(log(x), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Create unweighted Table 1
tbl1 <- nhanes_analysis %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = AgeGroup,
    include = c(
      Age, Sex, Race_Ethnicity, Income_Ratio,
      Cotinine, CRP, WBC, Lymphocytes, Neutrophils,
      PFOA, PFOS, PFNA, PFHxS
    ),
    label = list(
  Age ~ "Age (years)",
  Sex ~ "Sex",
  Race_Ethnicity ~ "Race/Ethnicity",
  Income_Ratio ~ "Income-to-poverty ratio",
  Cotinine ~ "Serum cotinine (ng/mL)",
  CRP ~ "C-reactive protein (mg/L)",
  WBC ~ "White blood cell count (10⁹/L)",
  Lymphocytes ~ "Lymphocytes (%)",
  Neutrophils ~ "Neutrophils (%)",
  PFOA ~ "PFOA (ng/mL)",
  PFOS ~ "PFOS (ng/mL)",
  PFNA ~ "PFNA (ng/mL)",
  PFHxS ~ "PFHxS (ng/mL)"
  ),
    statistic = list(
  # Demographic variables
  Age ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
  Income_Ratio ~ "{mean} ({sd})",

  # Biomarkers
  Cotinine ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
  CRP ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
  WBC ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",

  # Differential counts
  Lymphocytes ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
  Neutrophils ~ "{mean} ({sd})",

  # PFAS
  PFOA ~ "{geo_mean} ({geo_sd})",
  PFOS ~ "{geo_mean} ({geo_sd})",
  PFNA ~ "{geo_mean} ({geo_sd})",
  PFHxS ~ "{geo_mean} ({geo_sd})",

  # Categorical
  Sex ~ "{n} ({p})",
  Race_Ethnicity ~ "{n} ({p})"),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 2,
      all_categorical() ~ list(n = 0, p = 1)),
    percent = "column",
    missing = "no") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption(
    paste0(
      "Table 1. Characteristics of the study population in NHANES 2015–2018 (n = ",
      nrow(nhanes_analysis), ").")) %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~
      "Continuous variables are presented as mean (SD) for age, income-to-poverty ratio, lymphocytes, and neutrophils; geometric mean (GSD) for PFAS concentrations; and median (IQR) for serum cotinine, C-reactive protein, and white blood cell count. Categorical variables are presented as n (%). The income-to-poverty ratio represents total family income divided by the federal poverty threshold for family size and survey year, with values <1 indicating income below the poverty line. Abbreviations: PFOA, perfluorooctanoic acid; PFOS, perfluoroctane sulfonate; PFNA, perfluorononanoic acid; PFHxS, perfluorohexane sulfonate.",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)

tbl1
```

```{r}
# Save Table 1
tbl1 %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gtsave("outputs/Table1_NHANES_2015_2018.html")
```
